Elder.title: Elder Web App
Elder.subtitle: Elder-first safety interface (mobile only)
Elder.homeReady: Your details are ready. Use the button below if you need to change them.
Elder.emergencyBody: This page will later connect the emergency countdown and help flow.
Elder.assistBody: This page will later connect the voice help request flow.
Elder.recordsBody: This page will later show the status of your help requests.

LocationShare.keepOpen: Please keep this page open so your location can update.
LocationShare.denied: Location is blocked. Turn on Location in settings, then share again.
LocationShare.unavailable: Location is unavailable. Move to a place with better signal.
LocationShare.timeout: Getting location is too slow. Wait a moment or move outdoors.
LocationShare.failed: Could not update location. Check your network and try again.
LocationShare.inaccurate: Location is not accurate enough. Move near a window or outdoors.
LocationShare.stoppedHint: Sharing stopped. Tap Share location again if you still need help.
LocationShare.autoStopped: Your request has ended. Location sharing stopped automatically.

VoiceAssist.title: Want someone with me
VoiceAssist.hint: Tap once to start talking. Say what help you need.
VoiceAssist.maxSeconds: Up to {seconds} seconds. It stops automatically.
VoiceAssist.reviewHint: You can listen again. Re-record if needed, or send it.
VoiceAssist.submitted: Volunteers have been notified. Please wait.
VoiceAssist.unsupported: This phone cannot record audio. Please try again in a newer Safari or Chrome.
VoiceAssist.micDeniedTitle: Microphone is blocked. Please turn it on in phone settings.
VoiceAssist.micDeniedIphone: iPhone: open Settings → Safari → Microphone → Allow; or Settings → ElderSafe → turn on Microphone.
VoiceAssist.micDeniedAndroid: Android: open Settings → Apps → your browser (Chrome) → Permissions → turn on Microphone.
VoiceAssist.tryAgain: I turned on permission. Try again
VoiceAssist.micError: Could not start recording. Please try again.
VoiceAssist.locationDenied: Location is blocked. Turn on Location in settings, then tap Send again.
VoiceAssist.locationError: Could not read location. Move to a place with signal, then tap Send again.
VoiceAssist.submitFailed: Could not send. Check your network and try again.
VoiceAssist.statusHint: The status will update after a volunteer accepts.
VoiceAssist.statusLoadFailed: Could not load the request status. Please try again later.

Onboarding.submitFailed: Could not save your details. Please try again.
Onboarding.consentLabel: I agree that the system may use my details and location for safety purposes
Onboarding.healthNotesHint: Optional. You can write long-term conditions or medicine allergies here.

name.too_long: That name is too long. Please keep it within 80 characters.

age.age_invalid: Please enter a whole-number age from 1 to 130, for example 75.

phone.phone_invalid: Please enter an 8-digit Hong Kong phone number, for example 91234567. You may include 852, but do not add spaces or other symbols.

address.too_long: That address is too long. Please keep it within 300 characters.

emergencyContactName.required: Please enter the emergency contact name.
emergencyContactName.too_long: That name is too long. Please keep it within 80 characters.

emergencyContactPhone.required: Please enter the emergency contact phone number.
emergencyContactPhone.phone_invalid: Please enter an 8-digit Hong Kong phone number, for example 91234567. You may include 852, but do not add spaces or other symbols.

healthNotes.too_long: Those health notes are too long. Please keep them within 1000 characters, or tap Skip this question.

consent.consent_required: Please tick the consent box so we can use your details and location to keep you safe.

language.language_invalid: The language setting is invalid. Please choose a language and try again.

Profile.title: Edit my details
Profile.subtitle: Tap Save when you finish.
Profile.saveFailed: Could not save. Please check the red messages and try again.

DesignTest.title: Design system test
DesignTest.subtitle: Review big buttons, big text, colour contrast, and page frame
DesignTest.bodySample: Body text (20px minimum). Keep screens simple, with one main action per screen.
DesignTest.colorNote: Emergency red and assist blue both meet WCAG AA contrast.
DesignTest.pageNote: This page already shows the large back button and language switcher.
